dialogues.jp:
休みの最中の日曜日というのは、ありがたみが
ない。
dialogues.en:
During breaks, there's no real difference between Sunday and
any other day.
dialogues.text:
During breaks, there's no real difference between Sunday and
any other day.

dialogues.jp:
むしろ、休んでいる店がある訳だから、実は平
日より不便になるのだ。
dialogues.en:
If anything, Sundays are even less convenient, since most
stores don't open then.
dialogues.text:
If anything, Sundays are even less convenient, since most
stores don't open then.

dialogues.jp:
それでも、よく行く本屋とかコンビニとかは日
曜日でも開いているので、それほど困る訳では
ない。
dialogues.en:
Since book and convenience stores still opened on Sunday
though, I didn't have anyhting to worry about today.
dialogues.text:
Since book and convenience stores still opened on Sunday
though, I didn't have anyhting to worry about today.

dialogues.jp:
ちょうど昨日発売されたマンガを買いに本屋へ
行く道を歩いていると、目の前を見覚えのある
女の子が歩いているのに気づいた。
dialogues.en:
As I made my way to the bookstore to pick up some manga, I
found a familiar-looking girl walking in the same direction.
dialogues.text:
As I made my way to the bookstore to pick up some manga, I
found a familiar-looking girl walking in the same direction.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、その女の子の肩をポンと叩く。
dialogues.en: I tapped the girl lightly on the shoulder.
dialogues.text: I tapped the girl lightly on the shoulder.

dialogues.jp: 「よぉ、月城。買い物か？」
dialogues.en: "Yo, Tsukishiro, Shopping?"
dialogues.text: "Yo, Tsukishiro, Shopping?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、先輩」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura, senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura, senpai."

dialogues.jp:
私服姿でも、人形は肌身離さず持っているらし
い。いつものようにしっかりと抱いていた。
dialogues.en:
Even while in her casual clothes, she still held on tightly
to her doll.
dialogues.text:
Even while in her casual clothes, she still held on tightly
to her doll.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……買い物です」
dialogues.en: "...Yes I am."
dialogues.text: "...Yes I am."

dialogues.jp:
月城はそう言って、少し前の方にある本屋を指
さした。
dialogues.en:
She pointed to the bookstore in front of us; apparently that
was her destination.
dialogues.text:
She pointed to the bookstore in front of us; apparently that
was her destination.

dialogues.jp:
「奇遇だな。俺も本屋に行くところだ。一緒に
　行こう」
dialogues.en: "Nice, I was planning to go there too. Let's go."
dialogues.text: "Nice, I was planning to go there too. Let's go."

dialogues.jp:
俺と月城は、揃って本屋に行き、買い物を済ま
せる。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro and I entered the bookshop, and finished with our
shopping quickly.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro and I entered the bookshop, and finished with our
shopping quickly.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、あまり店内をうろつくということはせ
ず、お目当ての本が見つかると、すぐにレジで
精算をしていた。
dialogues.en:
After finding what she wanted, she immediately headed to the
register to pay for it.
dialogues.text:
After finding what she wanted, she immediately headed to the
register to pay for it.

dialogues.jp: 「何を買ったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What did you buy?"
dialogues.text: "What did you buy?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……この本」
dialogues.en: "...This book."
dialogues.text: "...This book."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、紙袋のテープをはがし、中の本を見せ
てくれた。
dialogues.en:
She broke the tape on the paper bag, letting me see what was
inside.
dialogues.text:
She broke the tape on the paper bag, letting me see what was
inside.

dialogues.jp:
それは、植物の育て方の本と、外国の植物の図
鑑だった。
dialogues.en: It was a foreign book on how to grow plants.
dialogues.text: It was a foreign book on how to grow plants.

dialogues.jp: 「ロスキルラベンダーの……」
dialogues.en: "For the Roskill Lavender...?"
dialogues.text: "For the Roskill Lavender...?"

dialogues.jp: 月城はこくんと頷いた。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro nodded.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro nodded.

dialogues.jp:
「悪かったな、昨日は花は咲かない、なんて言っ
　ちゃって」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry about yesterday. I said some very discuraging
things."
dialogues.text:
"Sorry about yesterday. I said some very discuraging
things."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ううん」

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「まだ、あの草が枯れた訳じゃないのに。可能
　性がゼロでないなら、あきらめるべきではな
　いんだよな」
dialogues.en:
"As long as that plant hasn't wilted, as long as the chance
isn't 0%, there's no reason to give up."
dialogues.text:
"As long as that plant hasn't wilted, as long as the chance
isn't 0%, there's no reason to give up."

dialogues.jp: 月城は、そう言って本をしまい、小脇に抱えた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro seemed to grip the book under her arm even more
tightly, after hearing my words.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro seemed to grip the book under her arm even more
tightly, after hearing my words.

dialogues.jp:
「そうだ、公園に行かないか？　おいしいチョ
　コバナナを売ってるところがあるんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, do you want to go to the park? Delicious chocolate
bananas are sold there."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, do you want to go to the park? Delicious chocolate
bananas are sold there."

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷く、月城。
dialogues.en: She nodded.
dialogues.text: She nodded.

dialogues.jp: 「もしかして、知ってた？」
dialogues.en: "You knew about it already?"
dialogues.text: "You knew about it already?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……前、天枷さんが」
dialogues.en: "...From Amakase-san, before."
dialogues.text: "...From Amakase-san, before."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「なにっ？　美春のヤツめ、先を越されたな
　……」
dialogues.en: "What? That Miharu, stealing my thunder..."
dialogues.text: "What? That Miharu, stealing my thunder..."

dialogues.jp:
いつか、あいつの知らないバナナ情報を得て、
地団駄を踏ませてみたいものだ。
dialogues.en:
Whenver anything new and banana-related happens in this
island, Miharu's always the first to know, and popularize
it.
dialogues.text:
Whenver anything new and banana-related happens in this
island, Miharu's always the first to know, and popularize
it.

dialogues.jp: 相当、難しそうだが。
dialogues.en: She's a tough one to beat.
dialogues.text: She's a tough one to beat.

dialogues.jp:
「これを考えたヤツは偉いよな。カモとネギ、
　ゴハンと梅干しくらい素晴らしい組み合わせ
　だ」
dialogues.en:
"Whoever thought of this is a genius. It goes together like
duck and spring onion, like rice and dried plums!
dialogues.text:
"Whoever thought of this is a genius. It goes together like
duck and spring onion, like rice and dried plums!

dialogues.jp:
フレークをトッピングしたチョコバナナをかぶ
りつきながら、そんなくだらないことを言って
見る。
dialogues.en:
In pure ecstasy from my the flaked-topping chocolate banana,
I started rambling.
dialogues.text:
In pure ecstasy from my the flaked-topping chocolate banana,
I started rambling.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、こくんと頷きながら、ライムグリーン
のチョコミント味を食べていた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro politely nodded at my exaggeratedness, while
calmly eating her lime-green chocolate mint banana.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro politely nodded at my exaggeratedness, while
calmly eating her lime-green chocolate mint banana.

dialogues.jp:
「頑張って、世話をすれば、きっと咲くよな。
　育ちにくい植物なのに、あそこまで育ったん
　だもの」
dialogues.en:
"With lots of care and effort, I'm sure it'd bloom. It's
growing there after all, there's no reason why it can't."
dialogues.text:
"With lots of care and effort, I'm sure it'd bloom. It's
growing there after all, there's no reason why it can't."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……咲きます」
dialogues.en: "...It will bloom."
dialogues.text: "...It will bloom."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、俯いたまま、いつもより強い調子でそ
う言った。
dialogues.en:
With her head bowed slightly, she uttered those words as
strongly as she ever has.
dialogues.text:
With her head bowed slightly, she uttered those words as
strongly as she ever has.

dialogues.jp: 「俺は、月城を応援するよ」
dialogues.en: "And I'd help you make that happen."
dialogues.text: "And I'd help you make that happen."

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、今までだって応援していたわけだけ
ど、もう『咲かないかも』なんて思わないって
ことだ。
dialogues.en:
Of course, I've been doing that for awhile now. But for the
first time, I'd be doing it without any doubts of in my
mind.
dialogues.text:
Of course, I've been doing that for awhile now. But for the
first time, I'd be doing it without any doubts of in my
mind.

dialogues.jp:
「そうだ、今から、月城をいいところに連れてっ
　てやるよ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I know! I'd bring you to see a nice place."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I know! I'd bring you to see a nice place."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……いいところ？」
dialogues.en: "...A nice place?"
dialogues.text: "...A nice place?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、ついてきなって」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, just follow me."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, just follow me."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、月城の細い腕を掴んで、腰を上げる。
dialogues.en: I took Alice's slender hand, and stood up.
dialogues.text: I took Alice's slender hand, and stood up.

dialogues.jp:
『あっ』と小さな驚きの声をあげる月城を連れ
て、俺は、公園の林の中に入って行く。
dialogues.en:
She yelped a tiny "Ah" when I grabbed her hand, but she
quickly recovered and followed me deep into the forest of
the park.
dialogues.text:
She yelped a tiny "Ah" when I grabbed her hand, but she
quickly recovered and followed me deep into the forest of
the park.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……こ、こんな場所」
dialogues.en: "...T, this place."
dialogues.text: "...T, this place."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「いいから」
dialogues.en: "Great, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "Great, isn't it?"

dialogues.jp:
入り組んだ林の中を、右へ左へと進み、茂みを
越え、少し｛ひら／拓｝けた場所に出る。
dialogues.en:
Traversing through the forest, we eventually emerged out of
a thicket, and into the place.
dialogues.text:
Traversing through the forest, we eventually emerged out of
a thicket, and into the place.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ここは」
dialogues.en: "...This is..."
dialogues.text: "...This is..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「ここは、俺のヒミツの場所だ」
dialogues.en: "This is, my secret place."
dialogues.text: "This is, my secret place."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……秘密の場所？」
dialogues.en: "...Secret place?"
dialogues.text: "...Secret place?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「子どもの頃、遊んでた場所でな。林の奥にあ
　るせいか、滅多に誰も来ないんだ」
dialogues.en:
"When I was a kid, I'd play here all the time. It's so deep
in the forest, that no one would ever come here."
dialogues.text:
"When I was a kid, I'd play here all the time. It's so deep
in the forest, that no one would ever come here."

dialogues.jp:
そこは、真ん中に大きな大きな桜の木を迎え、
薄桃色の桜の花びらで満ちていた。
dialogues.en:
A truly large sakura tree stood proudly, constantly shedding
it's sakura petals.
dialogues.text:
A truly large sakura tree stood proudly, constantly shedding
it's sakura petals.

dialogues.jp:
見渡す限りの桜の木。桜の園。まるで現実では
ない別世界のようだ。
dialogues.en:
A sakura tree that seemed to go on forever. A garden of
sakuras. It felt like a scene taken straight from a
storybook.
dialogues.text:
A sakura tree that seemed to go on forever. A garden of
sakuras. It felt like a scene taken straight from a
storybook.

dialogues.jp:
「ひとりになりたい時や、気分がくさくさした
　時に来るんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Whenever I want to be alone, I just come here and think to
myself for awhile."
dialogues.text:
"Whenever I want to be alone, I just come here and think to
myself for awhile."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……きれい」
dialogues.en: "...It's pretty."
dialogues.text: "...It's pretty."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、桜の木を見上げながら、ぽかんと口を
開けていた。
dialogues.en: Tskushiro stared up at the sakura tree, her mouth agape.
dialogues.text: Tskushiro stared up at the sakura tree, her mouth agape.

dialogues.jp:
絶え間なく、桜の雪が降り注ぎ、辺りを常に一
色に染めていく。
dialogues.en:
The sakura petals dropped from the tree, painting all below
it sheer pink.
dialogues.text:
The sakura petals dropped from the tree, painting all below
it sheer pink.

dialogues.jp: 「月城にも見せたいと思ってさ」
dialogues.en: "I thought you'd like to see it."
dialogues.text: "I thought you'd like to see it."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai."

dialogues.jp: 月城が、手袋を外して人形を触る。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro took off her gloves.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro took off her gloves.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「ありがとう、先輩。こんな素敵なところに連
　れて来てくれて」
dialogues.en: "Thank you, senpai. This place is really lovely."
dialogues.text: "Thank you, senpai. This place is really lovely."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「喜んでくれて、嬉しいよ」
dialogues.en: "If you're happy, I am too."
dialogues.text: "If you're happy, I am too."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「ボクもアリスもすごく嬉しいよ」
dialogues.en: "Alice and I are both really happy!"
dialogues.text: "Alice and I are both really happy!"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「こんなところがあったなんて、ちっとも知ら
　なかったよ」
dialogues.en: "We never knew a place like this existed."
dialogues.text: "We never knew a place like this existed."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「そうだろ？　俺だって滅多に人には教えない
　んだ」
dialogues.en: "Correct. I told very few people about this place.
dialogues.text: "Correct. I told very few people about this place.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「そうなの？」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。こんな綺麗な場所なんだ、さすがに誰
　彼構わず連れてきたいって訳じゃないからな」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. Such a beautiful place would become meaningless if
anybody just came and went as they pleased.
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. Such a beautiful place would become meaningless if
anybody just came and went as they pleased.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.en: "...It's special?"
dialogues.text: "...It's special?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「うーん、まあ、特別ってほどでもないけど、
　やっぱり、特別なのかなぁ」
dialogues.en:
"Mm, well, it's not hugely special... but it's special to
me."
dialogues.text:
"Mm, well, it's not hugely special... but it's special to
me."

dialogues.jp: そこまで考えたことはなかったな。
dialogues.en: I never thought of it that way.
dialogues.text: I never thought of it that way.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、月城にこの場所を見せたいと思った。そ
れだけだ。
dialogues.en: I just wanted Tsukishiro to see this place, that was all.
dialogues.text: I just wanted Tsukishiro to see this place, that was all.

dialogues.jp: 「ただ、欠点がひとつだけある」
dialogues.en: "There's just one bad thing about this place."
dialogues.text: "There's just one bad thing about this place."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「欠点？」
dialogues.en: "Bad thing?"
dialogues.text: "Bad thing?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「ここにいると、現実世界を忘れそうになるこ
　とだ。残念ながら、俺達はメルヘンの国の住
　人じゃない」
dialogues.en:
"If you stay here too long, you may forget about the real
world. Unfortunately for us, we aren't residents of a
fairytale land."
dialogues.text:
"If you stay here too long, you may forget about the real
world. Unfortunately for us, we aren't residents of a
fairytale land."

dialogues.jp: などと、ちょっと詩的な言い方をしてみる。
dialogues.en: My speech was getting more and more poetic.
dialogues.text: My speech was getting more and more poetic.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……そうかもね」
dialogues.en: "...I wonder."
dialogues.text: "...I wonder."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「この世が、夢と魔法の世界だったら、もっと
　もっと面白いんだがな……」
dialogues.en:
"If this was world was one of dreams and magic, it'd be a
lot more interesting..."
dialogues.text:
"If this was world was one of dreams and magic, it'd be a
lot more interesting..."

dialogues.jp: 自分が、｛・・・・・・・・・・／他人の夢を見てしまう｝という力と、
dialogues.en:
I didn't think of my own powers to see other people's
dreams,
dialogues.text:
I didn't think of my own powers to see other people's
dreams,

dialogues.jp:
｛・・・・・・・・・・／和菓子を出してしまう｝という魔法の力を持って
いるメルヘン世界の住人だと言うことは、つゆ
ほども考えない。
dialogues.en: or to create wagashis, as real fairytale powers.
dialogues.text: or to create wagashis, as real fairytale powers.

dialogues.jp: たぶん、どちらも素敵な力じゃないからだろう。
dialogues.en: They're not exactly powers people dream of, after all.
dialogues.text: They're not exactly powers people dream of, after all.

dialogues.jp:
「お前さんは、ちょっぴりのメルヘン世界の住
　人みたいだけどな」
dialogues.en: "You two would probably fit right in though, heh."
dialogues.text: "You two would probably fit right in though, heh."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、月城の抱いている人形をツンとつついた。
dialogues.en:
I patted Tsukishiro's doll on the head, and felt a handful
of cotton.
dialogues.text:
I patted Tsukishiro's doll on the head, and felt a handful
of cotton.

dialogues.jp:
ぬいぐるみらしい綿の詰っている感触。やはり、
ただの人形のようだ。
dialogues.en: It really is just a normal doll.
dialogues.text: It really is just a normal doll.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「ボクは、アリスの伝えられない気持ちを伝え
　ているだけさ」
dialogues.en: "I'm just a spokesperson for Alice's feelings, that's all."
dialogues.text: "I'm just a spokesperson for Alice's feelings, that's all."

dialogues.jp:
人形は、手足ひとつ動かすことなく、そう言っ
た。
dialogues.en: The doll, as lifeless as ever, continued to speak.
dialogues.text: The doll, as lifeless as ever, continued to speak.

dialogues.jp: 「──そろそろ帰ろう」
dialogues.en: "--We should head back."
dialogues.text: "--We should head back."

dialogues.jp:
時々、思う。ずっとここにいたら、元の世界に
帰りたくなくなってしまう。
dialogues.en:
If we stay here too long, it feels like we won't be able to
go back to the real world.
dialogues.text:
If we stay here too long, it feels like we won't be able to
go back to the real world.

dialogues.jp:
そして、いつかは本当に帰れなくなってしまう
のではないだろうかと。
dialogues.en: And maybe someday, that might actually happen.
dialogues.text: And maybe someday, that might actually happen.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp:
俺と月城は、メルヘンの世界を振り返らないよ
うに公園に向かって歩いた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro and I exited the fairytale land, and reappeared
into the park.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro and I exited the fairytale land, and reappeared
into the park.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「……先輩、素敵な場所を教えてくれてありが
　とう」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, thank you so much for showing us that place."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, thank you so much for showing us that place."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「タマに来るなら、いいだろ？　でも、あんま
　り人に教えちゃダメだぜ？」
dialogues.en:
"You can go there whenever you want, but don't tell anyone
else about it, alright?"
dialogues.text:
"You can go there whenever you want, but don't tell anyone
else about it, alright?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「うん、わかったよ。あの場所のことは、秘密
　にするよ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, understood. It's a secret place, after all."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, understood. It's a secret place, after all."

dialogues.jp:
月城と話してるんだか、人形と話してるんだか
よくわからないが、まあいいか……。
dialogues.en:
Whether it was Tsukishiro or the doll speaking, I couldn't
tell. But oh well...
dialogues.text:
Whether it was Tsukishiro or the doll speaking, I couldn't
tell. But oh well...

dialogues.jp:
ここに戻ってくると、現実に帰ってきたんだと
いう気がする。
dialogues.en: Coming back from that place was like coming back to reality.
dialogues.text: Coming back from that place was like coming back to reality.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、あの場所と大して変わらない公園の空気
を胸一杯に吸い込み、ゆっくりと吐いた。
dialogues.en:
I took a deep breath of air to reacquaint myself with the
usual atmosphere.
dialogues.text:
I took a deep breath of air to reacquaint myself with the
usual atmosphere.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おお、そこを歩いているのは朝倉と月城嬢で
　はないか。ちょうどよかった」
dialogues.en: "Ohh, Asakura and Tsukishiro-jou! What fortune!"
dialogues.text: "Ohh, Asakura and Tsukishiro-jou! What fortune!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、杉並かよ」
dialogues.en: "What, Suginami."
dialogues.text: "What, Suginami."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだとはなんだ。探していたんだぞ？」
dialogues.en: "Don't just what me. I've been looking all over!"
dialogues.text: "Don't just what me. I've been looking all over!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「探していた？」
dialogues.en: "Looking all over?"
dialogues.text: "Looking all over?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「うむ、ピロスキーにぜひ対決を申し込みたい
　と思ってな」
dialogues.en: "Mm, to have a showdown with Pirosuki."
dialogues.text: "Mm, to have a showdown with Pirosuki."

dialogues.jp:
杉並はそう言って、なんだかよくわからないが
大きな人形を俺達に見せる。
dialogues.en:
Just as he finished speaking, he pulled out an
enormous-looking doll from seemingly nowhere.
dialogues.text:
Just as he finished speaking, he pulled out an
enormous-looking doll from seemingly nowhere.

dialogues.jp: 「な、なんだ、それは！」
dialogues.en: "T, the hell is that!?"
dialogues.text: "T, the hell is that!?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「これは、日本が世界に誇る伝統芸能、浄瑠璃
　人形だ」
dialogues.en:
"This is a proud relic of Japanese heritage, the bunraku
theatre puppet!"
dialogues.text:
"This is a proud relic of Japanese heritage, the bunraku
theatre puppet!"

dialogues.jp:
杉並が手を動かすと、着物を着た、女性型の和
人形は眉や目を器用に動かし表情を作った。
dialogues.en:
Suginami moved his hand, and the kimono-wearing ladylike
doll moved it's lips and eyes in tandem.
dialogues.text:
Suginami moved his hand, and the kimono-wearing ladylike
doll moved it's lips and eyes in tandem.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「江戸時代より、庶民に親しまれた人形劇だ。
　現在では随分と廃れてしまったが、それでも
　世界的な評価は非常に高い」
dialogues.en:
"Famous in the Edo period, although it has since become
outdated, it's value is still unparalled to the collector!"
dialogues.text:
"Famous in the Edo period, although it has since become
outdated, it's value is still unparalled to the collector!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……なんでお前がその人形を持ってるんだよ」
dialogues.en: "...Why do you have something like that?"
dialogues.text: "...Why do you have something like that?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと、あるスジから借りてきたんだよ。
　本来は３人で動かすものだが、表情だけなら
　ひとりで充分だ」
dialogues.en:
"My contacts are far and wide. In truth, this is supposed to
take 3 men to control it, but for just the face, one is
perfect!"
dialogues.text:
"My contacts are far and wide. In truth, this is supposed to
take 3 men to control it, but for just the face, one is
perfect!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そんなくだらないものを……」
dialogues.en: "This is so lame..."
dialogues.text: "This is so lame..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「くだらないだと？　伝統芸能をバカにするな。
　一時期は捕鯨禁止で材料のクジラのヒゲが手
　に入らず絶滅の危機にもさらされたんだぞ」
dialogues.en:
"You dare call this work of art, lame? What an unrefined
neanderthal! Whale-fishing was explicitly banned due to this
item!"
dialogues.text:
"You dare call this work of art, lame? What an unrefined
neanderthal! Whale-fishing was explicitly banned due to this
item!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「知るかよ。怖いんだよ、その人形。月城だっ
　て怖がってるぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"I know, and it's still scary. Don't you think so,
Tsukishiro?"
dialogues.text:
"I know, and it's still scary. Don't you think so,
Tsukishiro?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほう、月城嬢もこの人形が嫌いかな？」
dialogues.en: "Oh really. Tsukishiro-jou doesn't like this doll?"
dialogues.text: "Oh really. Tsukishiro-jou doesn't like this doll?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……いえ、その」
dialogues.en: "...No, that's..."
dialogues.text: "...No, that's..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「こんな人形もあるぞ？」
dialogues.en: "I still have one more than might suit your fancy!"
dialogues.text: "I still have one more than might suit your fancy!"

dialogues.jp:
杉並はどこからか、もうひとつの人形を取り出
す。
dialogues.en:
Once again, from nowhere, Suginami pulled out yet another
doll.
dialogues.text:
Once again, from nowhere, Suginami pulled out yet another
doll.

dialogues.jp:
そちらも、綺麗な真っ白い顔をした女性の人形
で、怖いと言いつつも、俺もその人形に慎まし
さを感じてしまった。
dialogues.en:
This one was ladylike as well, but had a pale white, and
beautiful face. Even then, coming from Suginami, it still
made me wary.
dialogues.text:
This one was ladylike as well, but had a pale white, and
beautiful face. Even then, coming from Suginami, it still
made me wary.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「綺麗だろ？　だがな……」
dialogues.en: "Exquisite, isn't it? However!"
dialogues.text: "Exquisite, isn't it? However!"

dialogues.jp: ──カーッ！！
dialogues.en: --*bang!*
dialogues.text: --*bang!*

dialogues.jp:
杉並がそう言った瞬間、その人形の顔がばっく
りと割れ、鬼のような顔に変化した。
dialogues.en:
Right as Suginami finished his sentence, the doll's face
exploded, revealing a demon's face undernearth.
dialogues.text:
Right as Suginami finished his sentence, the doll's face
exploded, revealing a demon's face undernearth.

dialogues.jp: 「うっ、うわああッ！」
dialogues.en: "W, waaahhh!"
dialogues.text: "W, waaahhh!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ははははは、どうだ、日本伝統芸能の恐ろし
　さを。このサイズの人形にこんな奇妙なギミッ
　クを仕込むのは日本人くらいだ」
dialogues.en:
"Hahahaha, feel the terror of the bunraku theatre! A doll of
this size having such a feature, it truly is a work of
Japan!"
dialogues.text:
"Hahahaha, feel the terror of the bunraku theatre! A doll of
this size having such a feature, it truly is a work of
Japan!"

dialogues.jp:
月城を見ると、さすがに驚いたらしく、目を見
張ったまま動きが止まっていた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro was surprised as well, but her eyes remained
locked to the doll.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro was surprised as well, but her eyes remained
locked to the doll.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「さて……と。わざわざ遊びでこんな人形を持っ
　て来たわけではない。俺はピロスキーと腹話
　術対決をしに来たんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Now then...I didn't come here to to play around with dolls.
Pirosuki, I challenge you to a duel!"
dialogues.text:
"Now then...I didn't come here to to play around with dolls.
Pirosuki, I challenge you to a duel!"

dialogues.jp: ……思い切り、遊びに来てんじゃねーか。
dialogues.en: ...Of course you did, sheesh.
dialogues.text: ...Of course you did, sheesh.

dialogues.jp:
こいつ、もしかしてその人形を持ったまま、俺
達を探しまくってたんじゃないだろうな。
dialogues.en:
He came all this way to search for us just to show off those
dolls?
dialogues.text:
He came all this way to search for us just to show off those
dolls?

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「ボクはピロスキーじゃないよ！　ピロスだよ」
dialogues.en: "My name isn't Pirosuki! It's Piros!"
dialogues.text: "My name isn't Pirosuki! It's Piros!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふ、対決する気になったか……」
dialogues.en: "Hm, seems that ignited your fighting spirit..."
dialogues.text: "Hm, seems that ignited your fighting spirit..."

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、ナントカという人形を前に出し、喋り
始める。
dialogues.en:
Suginami placed the doll in front of him, then started to
speak.
dialogues.text:
Suginami placed the doll in front of him, then started to
speak.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちわで、ありんす」
dialogues.en: "Good afternoon to you!"
dialogues.text: "Good afternoon to you!"

dialogues.jp: かくんと頭を下げる人形。
dialogues.en: The doll deeply bowed.
dialogues.text: The doll deeply bowed.

dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと待てッ。なんだその喋り方は……。
　ホントにそんな喋り方をするのか？」
dialogues.en: "Wait a minute, that was... was it really talking?"
dialogues.text: "Wait a minute, that was... was it really talking?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「はて、どうだろうな。そこまではチェックし
　ていないが……まあいいじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Who knows. I never quite checked... but it doesn't matter!"
dialogues.text: "Who knows. I never quite checked... but it doesn't matter!"

dialogues.jp: 杉並は再び人形を構える。
dialogues.en: Suginami sat the doll up once again.
dialogues.text: Suginami sat the doll up once again.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「腹話術、たいそうお上手どすなぁ」
dialogues.en: "I've heard your ventriloquism is fantastic!"
dialogues.text: "I've heard your ventriloquism is fantastic!"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「腹話術なんかじゃないよ。ボクが喋ってるん
　だ！」
dialogues.en: "It's not ventriloquism! I'm really talking!"
dialogues.text: "It's not ventriloquism! I'm really talking!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「せっかくお上手なのに、ご主人様は喋らない
　んどすなぁ」
dialogues.en:
"But as fantastic as it is, your master not talking drags it
down."
dialogues.text:
"But as fantastic as it is, your master not talking drags it
down."

dialogues.jp:
杉並の人形が、手を口に添え、くっくっくと笑っ
ているかのように、まゆ毛をカクカクと細かに
動かした。
dialogues.en:
Suginami's doll put a hand to it's mouth, and laughed
mockingly, it's hair flopping with it's movements.
dialogues.text:
Suginami's doll put a hand to it's mouth, and laughed
mockingly, it's hair flopping with it's movements.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「腹話術なら、ご主人様と会話をしてこそ。そ
　うどすな、杉並様」
dialogues.en:
"Ventriloquism is all about the conversations between master
and doll, is it not, Suginami-sama?"
dialogues.text:
"Ventriloquism is all about the conversations between master
and doll, is it not, Suginami-sama?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「うむ、そうとも月姫」
dialogues.en: "Quite right, my princess."
dialogues.text: "Quite right, my princess."

dialogues.jp:
杉並が人形に向かって、うんうんと頷いてみせ
る。何やってんだ、コイツは。
dialogues.en:
Suginami and his doll nodded in perfect unison. The hell is
he doing...
dialogues.text:
Suginami and his doll nodded in perfect unison. The hell is
he doing...

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「だって、ボクはアリスの気持ちを代弁してあ
　げてるだけだもの」
dialogues.en: "But I'm here to help Alice communicate her feelings."
dialogues.text: "But I'm here to help Alice communicate her feelings."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ご主人様が自分で喋ればいいんじゃないどす
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Wouldn't that be better for your master to say herself?"
dialogues.text: "Wouldn't that be better for your master to say herself?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ピロスキーがお喋りなだけかもしれないぞ」
dialogues.en: "Maybe our dear Pirosuki is just a chatterbox."
dialogues.text: "Maybe our dear Pirosuki is just a chatterbox."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「都合の悪いことは全部人形のせいにするつも
　りなのかもしれまへんなぁ」
dialogues.en: "But that may well be a trouble of puppets the world over."
dialogues.text: "But that may well be a trouble of puppets the world over."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことないよ！　アリスが口べただから、
　代わってあげてるだけだよ」
dialogues.en:
"That's not true! Alice is bad at speaking, so I do it for
her instead!"
dialogues.text:
"That's not true! Alice is bad at speaking, so I do it for
her instead!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほんまですかねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Would that really be true?"
dialogues.text: "Would that really be true?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「俺は、月姫に喋らせたりはしないぞ。俺の言
　葉は俺の口から出るものでなければならない
　からな」
dialogues.en:
"I will not let you speak for me, my princess. My words will
come from my mouth, and no other!"
dialogues.text:
"I will not let you speak for me, my princess. My words will
come from my mouth, and no other!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「やめろッ！　杉並。お前、いったいなんのつ
　もりがあって……」
dialogues.en: "Stop it!! Suginami, what are you trying to do..."
dialogues.text: "Stop it!! Suginami, what are you trying to do..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おや、朝倉はんが怒っておいでですえ」
dialogues.en: "My, Asakura has gotten angry!"
dialogues.text: "My, Asakura has gotten angry!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そのようだな。冗談も通じないとはな」
dialogues.en: "So it seems. Some people just can't take a joke."
dialogues.text: "So it seems. Some people just can't take a joke."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「冗談だと！？　こんなタチの悪い冗談をやっ
　て何が面白いんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Joke!? How is this kind of horrible joke supposed to be
funny!?"
dialogues.text:
"Joke!? How is this kind of horrible joke supposed to be
funny!?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「……やめてよ、朝倉先輩！　杉並先輩は悪く
　ないから」
dialogues.en:
"...Don't, Asakura-senpai! I'm sure Suginami-senpai meant
well!"
dialogues.text:
"...Don't, Asakura-senpai! I'm sure Suginami-senpai meant
well!"

dialogues.jp:
言葉だけは人形のままの月城が、俺の袖をぐっ
と掴む。
dialogues.en:
As the doll's words reached my ears, I felt my shirt sleeve
being held on to tightly.
dialogues.text:
As the doll's words reached my ears, I felt my shirt sleeve
being held on to tightly.

dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro..."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、杉並に掴みかかろうとした腕を降ろす。
dialogues.en: I let go of Suginami's collar, and lowered my fist.
dialogues.text: I let go of Suginami's collar, and lowered my fist.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「人形の喋ったことにいちいち腹を立ててると
　キリがないぞ」
dialogues.en: "You take a mere doll's words way too seriously."
dialogues.text: "You take a mere doll's words way too seriously."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「人形じゃなくて、お前が喋ったんだろう？」
dialogues.en: "That was you talking, wasn't it."
dialogues.text: "That was you talking, wasn't it."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いや？　俺も月城嬢と同じ力を持っているん
　だよ、実は」
dialogues.en:
"Was it? You didn't know that I have the same power as
Tsukishiro-jou?"
dialogues.text:
"Was it? You didn't know that I have the same power as
Tsukishiro-jou?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「訳のわからないことを言うな！」
dialogues.en: "Don't talk crap about things you don't know!"
dialogues.text: "Don't talk crap about things you don't know!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「さすがに冗談だが。──しかし、思ったより
　つまらなかったな。朝倉、この人形はお前に
　くれてやろう」
dialogues.en:
"It's just a joke. --This has gotten more boring than I
thought it'd be. Asakura, you can have this."
dialogues.text:
"It's just a joke. --This has gotten more boring than I
thought it'd be. Asakura, you can have this."

dialogues.jp:
杉並はそう言うと、手に持っていた大きな人形
を俺に投げてよこした。
dialogues.en: He threw the doll at me carelessly.
dialogues.text: He threw the doll at me carelessly.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあな、朝倉に月城嬢、ついでにピロスキー
　だったか？」
dialogues.en:
"See you, Asakura and Tsukishiro-jou, and should I say,
Pirosuki?"
dialogues.text:
"See you, Asakura and Tsukishiro-jou, and should I say,
Pirosuki?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並は俺達の方をにやりと見て笑うと、そのま
ま、言葉通り、煙を巻くようにどこかへ消えて
いってしまった。
dialogues.en: Suginami grinned at us, then disappeared in a puff of smoke.
dialogues.text: Suginami grinned at us, then disappeared in a puff of smoke.

dialogues.jp: 「……あいつ、いったいなんのつもりだ」
dialogues.en: "...What the hell was he doing..."
dialogues.text: "...What the hell was he doing..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、腕の中で黒い瞳で俺を見つめる人形を眺
めながら、ぼそりと呟いた。
dialogues.en:
I stared at the soulless black eyes of the doll in frnt of
me, while muttering to myself.
dialogues.text:
I stared at the soulless black eyes of the doll in frnt of
me, while muttering to myself.

dialogues.jp: 袖に、ぎゅっと握る感触が伝わってくる。
dialogues.en: I felt another tug on my sleeve.
dialogues.text: I felt another tug on my sleeve.

dialogues.en: "...Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text: "...Tsukishiro."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……杉並先輩は、悪くないから」
dialogues.en: "...Suginami-senpai didn't mean to be like that."
dialogues.text: "...Suginami-senpai didn't mean to be like that."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「でも、あいつのやった冗談はタチが悪すぎる。
　今度会ったら、俺がぶっ飛ばしてやる」
dialogues.en:
"He still took that way too far. I'm going to teach him a
lesson next time I see him..."
dialogues.text:
"He still took that way too far. I'm going to teach him a
lesson next time I see him..."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……ダメだよ、そんなことしちゃ」
dialogues.en: "...You can't do that!"
dialogues.text: "...You can't do that!"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「しかし……」

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.en: "...You can't."
dialogues.text: "...You can't."

dialogues.jp: 月城がふるふると首を横に振る。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro shook her head no, firmly.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro shook her head no, firmly.

dialogues.jp:
そして、手袋をはめ直し、寂しそうな目で俺の
顔を見上げた。
dialogues.en:
She replaced her gloves, and looked at me with lonesome
eyes.
dialogues.text:
She replaced her gloves, and looked at me with lonesome
eyes.

dialogues.jp:
少し濡れた小さな唇が動き、ガラスのような声
が俺の耳に届く。
dialogues.en: The trembling lips, and the voice as thin as glass.
dialogues.text: The trembling lips, and the voice as thin as glass.

dialogues.jp:
「……わかったよ。月城が気にしてないんだっ
　たら、俺はもうなにも言わないよ」
dialogues.en:
"...Okay, okay. If you don't want me to, I won't say
anything."
dialogues.text:
"...Okay, okay. If you don't want me to, I won't say
anything."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp: 月城が、俺の腕をぎゅっと握る。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro continued to grip tightly onto my arm.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro continued to grip tightly onto my arm.

dialogues.jp:
か細い腕が俺の腕にぴたりとくっつく。ほのか
な温かみが、ゆっくりと伝わってきた。
dialogues.en:
That thin arm seemed to be slowly transferring it's heat to
me.
dialogues.text:
That thin arm seemed to be slowly transferring it's heat to
me.

dialogues.jp: 「……月城さぁ、この人形……いる？」
dialogues.en: "...Tsukishiro, this doll... do you...?"
dialogues.text: "...Tsukishiro, this doll... do you...?"

dialogues.jp:
きょとんとした顔で、ふるふると首を横に振る
月城。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro simply shook her head no.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro simply shook her head no.

dialogues.jp: 「……だよなぁ」
dialogues.en: "...I suppose."
dialogues.text: "...I suppose."

dialogues.jp: どうしよう、コレ。
dialogues.en: What should I do with this... thing?
dialogues.text: What should I do with this... thing?

dialogues.jp: ◆メルヘンとリアル◆
dialogues.en: ◆Fantasy And Reality◆
dialogues.text: ◆Fantasy And Reality◆

dialogues.jp:
俺は、月城に、花が咲かないなんて言ったこと
を謝った。曲がりなりにも育たないと言われた
草が育っているのだ。
dialogues.en:
I apologied to Tsukishiro for telling her that the flower
won't bloom. The flower somehow is growing here, so there
must be a chance.
dialogues.text:
I apologied to Tsukishiro for telling her that the flower
won't bloom. The flower somehow is growing here, so there
must be a chance.

dialogues.jp:
きっと花だって、咲くに違いない。いや、咲く
と信じていなければならないのだ。
dialogues.en: Surely, the flower will bloom. No, if we believe, it will.
dialogues.text: Surely, the flower will bloom. No, if we believe, it will.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、お詫びといっては何だが、例の秘密基地
へ月城を連れて行く。
dialogues.en: As part of my apology, I took her to my former secret base.
dialogues.text: As part of my apology, I took her to my former secret base.

dialogues.jp:
このあり得ない風景が存在している前で、花が
咲かないと決めるなんて、バカバカしい。
dialogues.en:
Beholding such incredibly scenery, I felt so stupid to think
that the flower definitely wouldn't bloom.
dialogues.text:
Beholding such incredibly scenery, I felt so stupid to think
that the flower definitely wouldn't bloom.

dialogues.jp:
その帰り、杉並に遭遇する。杉並は浄瑠璃人形
を持ち出し、月城の人形と対決するというのだ。
dialogues.en:
On the way back, we encountered Suginami. Suginami had a
bunraku theater doll with him, and challenged Tsukishiro to
a showdown.
dialogues.text:
On the way back, we encountered Suginami. Suginami had a
bunraku theater doll with him, and challenged Tsukishiro to
a showdown.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、杉並がしたこととは、人形でしか喋ろ
うとしない月城を責め立てるだけだった。
dialogues.en:
But the showdown was less of a duel, and more of Suginami
torturing Tsukishiro about her weaknesses.
dialogues.text:
But the showdown was less of a duel, and more of Suginami
torturing Tsukishiro about her weaknesses.

dialogues.jp:
人形にばかり喋らせるのは、自分の言葉に責任
を取りたくないからなのか──など、そんな言
葉ばかりを月城にぶつけるのだった。
dialogues.en:
Using the doll as a crutch, and not saying the things she
should-- his words continuously attacked Tsukishiro through
that angle.
dialogues.text:
Using the doll as a crutch, and not saying the things she
should-- his words continuously attacked Tsukishiro through
that angle.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、杉並をなんとか追い返し、自分の友人の
非礼を月城にわびた。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to chase after Suginami, for daring to do such a
thing to her.
dialogues.text:
I wanted to chase after Suginami, for daring to do such a
thing to her.

dialogues.jp:
けれども、月城は、杉並は悪くない……だから
杉並を許してやって欲しいというのだった。
dialogues.en:
But Tsukishiro didn't think his intentions were bad... so
she wanted me to forgive him instead.
dialogues.text:
But Tsukishiro didn't think his intentions were bad... so
she wanted me to forgive him instead.

dialogues.jp: 月城は……いったい何を考えているのだろうか。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro... I wonder what she's reallyy thinking.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro... I wonder what she's reallyy thinking.
